description: As Alexander Hamilton wrote in Federalist No. 36, "Happy it is when the interest which the government has in the preservation of its own power, coincides with a proper distribution of public burdens, and tends to guard the least wealthy part of the community from oppression!" The facts today tell us that American socieity is far from this goal of a "proper distribution of public burdens" that Hamilton urged us to aim for. There can be no doubt that we today face a national crisis of income
